missing_information_behavior: Do not add another zinc product until elemental zinc per serving, frequency, duration and other sources are reconciled.
safety_exclusions: Do not equate compound weight with elemental zinc amount.
Do not infer copper deficiency from zinc use alone.
Do not recommend chronic high-dose zinc for immune support or other nonspecific goals.
professional_escalation_conditions: Long-term high-dose zinc, anemia, neutropenia, neurological symptoms or suspected copper deficiency.
Pregnancy, malabsorption or relevant medication interactions.
population_and_context: Users already taking a zinc-containing supplement or multiple products; total daily elemental zinc exposure and duration need review.
dose_constraints: No additional dose from this rule. Calculate total elemental zinc from all supplements and medications and compare with age-specific UL; clinician assessment may be needed for prolonged excess.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Zinc fact sheet describes upper limits and copper-related adverse effects from excessive intake; actual risk depends on dose, duration and individual context. This justification remains draft; source passage extraction, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional approval are required before activation.
